name: Alpasankhyak Post-Maitrik Chhaatravrtti Yojana
benefit:
1. Tuition fee of ₹3,000/- per year for graduate and postgraduate students.
1. Maintenance allowance of ₹570/- per month for undergraduate and postgraduate hostel students.
1. Maintenance allowance of ₹300/- per month for non-hostel students
1. Maintenance allowance M.Phil. And Ph.D. ₹1,200/- per month to hostel students.
1. Maintenance allowance of ₹550/- per month for non-hostel students
1. Main
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a native of the minority category of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The total annual income of the applicant's parents and guardian should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-.
1. Not less than 50 percent marks in the last qualifying examination.
